verification.summary: Reviewed all changed snapshots rather than refreshing hashes mechanically. Common source contracts remain verified; previous installations, model-specific timings/output identities and remote state remain historical. Current local runtime was preserved and the new source was not installed.

conclusion: A collision-safe CONTACT_TO_MODEL candidate does not establish a flat landing: only avoidance-classified gracious candidates and bed candidates set to_model_gracious. Keep ordinary collision-based model-resting propagation for inclined contacts, the local contact-footprint exception and minimum-thickness-aware independent bed placement. Exact source reconstruction proves these classifications and contact rules unchanged outside the reviewed radius/storage/scheduling substitutions. Current support and belt regressions pass. Earlier Benchy timing and output identities retain their historical scope; no new Benchy or multi-project identity claim is made.
